name: Seismic Smash scales with AP/STA and grants Thane's Rage and Aftershock (#5043, fix #7828)
contract: Issue #5043 (class 31 Primalist, lvl 60): Seismic Smash 300693 dealt about 60 damage instead of the tooltip's ~460, and granted neither Thane's Rage nor Aftershock. Spell.dbc 300693 Description: 'dealing ${$m1+0+$AP*.22+$STA*.5} Physical damage and granting you Thane's Rage and Aftershock', linked spells @s:804124:0@ (Thane's Rage) and @s:301086:0@ (Aftershock). Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 93, EffectDieSides 16, EffectRealPointsPerLevel 10.85, BaseLevel/SpellLevel 59. SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp) resolves this at level 60 (one level above BaseLevel) to 93 + int32(1 * 10.85) + irand(1, 16) = a 104-119 pre-AP/STA range, then calls sScriptMgr->ModifySpellEffectBaseValue before returning. primalist_seismic_smash_scaling (UnitScript, AscensionPrimalistSeismicResources.cpp) implements exactly that hook for a CLASS_WILDWALKER caster casting SeismicSmash's own first rank, adding GetTotalAttackPowerValue(BASE_ATTACK)*0.22 + GetStat(STAT_STAMINA)*0.5 to the effect value, matching the tooltip formula bit for bit; primalist_seismic_resources (AllSpellScript, OnSpellCast) casts ThanesRage(804124) and Aftershock(301086) on the same cast. A probe run on this tree (level 60 class-31 human, no gear) measured attack_power 126 and STAT_STAMINA 75 (deterministic base stats for that level/class/race with no items), giving an expected spell_effect_value(300693, effect 0) range of [104, 119] + (126*0.22 + 75*0.5 = 65.22) = [169.22, 184.22]; three live reads on this tree returned 171, 182 and 177, all inside that band and far above the pre-fix 104-119 band a missing hook would produce. Casting the spell must also grant both linked auras.
